question_english: Case Scenario: A school receives funds under Samagra Shiksha for purchasing assistive devices. The Principal decides to buy 10 high-end laptops for the computer lab instead of purchasing customized hearing aids and braille kits recommended by the special educator. This decision is:
options_english: Inappropriate, as earmarked CWSN funds must directly reduce specific disability barriers
Appropriate, because installing computer hardware in central labs delivers tangible academic benefits to a much larger volume of general education students
Appropriate, provided that portable laptop computers can theoretically be classified as assistive learning technology whenever any enrolled student accesses them
Inappropriate, strictly on the fiscal administrative grounds that annual allocated institutional funds ought to be conserved rather than spent on hardware
explanation_english: Under the Samagra Shiksha framework and the RPwD Act 2016, funds sanctioned under the inclusive education component for Children with Special Needs (CWSN) are strictly earmarked. These dedicated grants must be utilized exclusively for purchasing individualized assistive devices, specialized appliances, and accessibility resources (such as braille kits, hearing aids, tactile materials, and orthopedic aids) recommended by multidisciplinary teams and special educators. Diverting these funds to purchase general computer lab equipment violates statutory financial guidelines and deprives students with disabilities of essential accessibility tools necessary for equitable educational participation.
explanation_hindi: समग्र शिक्षा अभियान और दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम (RPwD Act, 2016) के तहत विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों (CWSN) के लिए जारी की गई वित्तीय सहायता विशिष्ट रूप से निर्धारित (Earmarked) होती है। इसका उपयोग केवल और केवल दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों के लिए अनुशंसित व्यक्तिगत सहायक उपकरणों (जैसे ब्रेल किट, श्रवण यंत्र, व्हीलचेयर आदि) को खरीदने में ही किया जा सकता है। इस धनराशि को सामान्य कंप्यूटर लैब के बुनियादी ढांचे में मोड़ना वित्तीय नियमों का उल्लंघन है और यह दिव्यांग छात्रों को उनकी अनिवार्य शिक्षण सामग्री से वंचित करता है। अतः प्रधानाचार्य का निर्णय सर्वथा अनुचित है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Inappropriate, as earmarked CWSN funds must directly reduce specific disability barriers

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Earmarked funds allocated under Samagra Shiksha for CWSN are legally restricted to purchasing specialized assistive devices, adaptive technologies, and accessibility supports recommended for students with disabilities. Diverting designated special education funds to general computer lab infrastructure violates financial propriety rules and denies disabled students essential accessibility tools.

question_english: The Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is a statutory body primarily responsible for:
options_english: Financing and overseeing civil construction projects for rural government school infrastructure
Designing, approving, and publishing the standardized general education curriculum for primary schools
Regulating special education training programs and registering rehabilitation personnel
Disbursing direct low-interest microfinance loans and business grants to individual persons with disabilities
explanation_english: The Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) was established as a statutory body by an Act of Parliament in 1992 (amended in 2000). Its primary legislative mandate is to regulate and standardize training policies and programs for professionals and personnel working in the field of disability rehabilitation and special education. RCI maintains the Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR) of qualified rehabilitation professionals and takes punitive action against unqualified individuals practicing in this domain across India.
explanation_hindi: भारतीय पुनर्वास परिषद (RCI) वर्ष 1992 में संसद के एक अधिनियम (2000 में संशोधित) द्वारा गठित एक सांविधिक निकाय (Statutory Body) है। इसका मुख्य विधिक उत्तरदायित्व विशेष शिक्षा और दिव्यांग पुनर्वास के क्षेत्र में प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रमों का मानकीकरण, विनियमन और निगरानी करना है। यह योग्य पेशेवरों का 'केंद्रीय पुनर्वास रजिस्टर' (Central Rehabilitation Register - CRR) बनाए रखती है और विशेष शिक्षकों तथा पुनर्वास विशेषज्ञों की पेशेवर योग्यताओं को प्रमाणित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Regulating special education training programs and registering rehabilitation personnel

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is a statutory body established by an Act of Parliament in 1992. Its primary mandate is to regulate, standardize, and monitor training programs for special educators and rehabilitation professionals, maintain the Central Rehabilitation Register, and enforce professional qualifications across the special education sector.

question_hindi: सरकारी दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, विशेष शिक्षक (Special Educator) के संबंध में नियमित कक्षा शिक्षक की अनुशंसित भूमिका क्या है?

question_english: According to government guidelines, what is the recommended role of a regular classroom teacher in relation to the Special Educator?
options_english: Collaborating with Special Educators to adapt instruction and implement IEPs in general classrooms
Transferring total instructional, assessment, and supervisory responsibility for all enrolled CWSN directly to the assigned Special Educator
Serving as the direct administrative line manager and official performance supervisor of all itinerant and school-based Special Educators
Disregarding input from Special Educators entirely to preserve absolute instructional authority and control over general classroom operations
explanation_english: National education frameworks and guidelines emphasize that regular classroom teachers hold primary educational responsibility for all enrolled learners in the general classroom, including students with disabilities. General education teachers are expected to collaborate actively with special educators to co-plan, differentiate instructional delivery, modify learning materials, and implement Individualized Education Plans (IEPs), thereby ensuring meaningful inclusion within mainstream academic settings.
explanation_hindi: सरकारी दिशा-निर्देशों एवं समावेशी शिक्षा नीतियों के अनुसार, सामान्य कक्षा शिक्षक अपनी कक्षा में नामांकित सभी विद्यार्थियों (जिसमें CWSN भी शामिल हैं) के प्राथमिक शिक्षक होते हैं। नियमित शिक्षकों से यह अपेक्षा की जाती है कि वे विशेष शिक्षकों के साथ घनिष्ठ सहयोग करें, शिक्षण विधियों को अनुकूलित करें, शिक्षण सामग्री में आवश्यक बदलाव करें और सामान्य कक्षा में 'वैयक्तिकृत शिक्षा योजना' (IEP) का प्रभावी क्रियान्वयन सुनिश्चित करें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Collaborating with Special Educators to adapt instruction and implement IEPs in general classrooms

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Government guidelines mandate that general education classroom teachers maintain primary responsibility for all enrolled students, including CWSN. General teachers must work collaboratively with special educators to adapt teaching methods, modify classroom learning materials, implement Individualized Education Plans, and ensure active participation of disabled students in mainstream settings.

question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में अंकित किया गया है।
अभिकथन (A): एक समावेशी विद्यालय में, CWSN के शैक्षणिक प्रदर्शन के संबंध में उनके अभिभावकों से संवाद करना केवल और केवल विशेष शिक्षक की जिम्मेदारी है।
कारण (R): समावेशी शिक्षा में एक सहयोगात्मक टीम दृष्टिकोण की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसमें सामान्य और विशेष शिक्षक दोनों मिलकर अभिभावकों के साथ संवाद करते हैं और उन्हें सहयोग देते हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है
A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): In an inclusive school, it is solely the responsibility of the Special Educator to communicate with the parents of CWSN regarding their child’s academic progress.
Reason (R): Inclusive education requires a collaborative team approach, wherein both general and special educators jointly communicate with and support the parents.
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: Assertion (A) is false: In an inclusive school, communicating with parents of CWSN is never the sole responsibility of the special educator. Because the student spends most of the school day under regular classroom teachers, general educators must actively engage with parents regarding curricular learning and social integration. Reason (R) is true: Genuine inclusive education relies on a multidisciplinary, collaborative team model where general educators, special educators, therapists, and school leaders jointly consult with parents to review IEP progress and coordinate home-school support strategies. Hence, A is false but R is true.
explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) गलत है: समावेशी विद्यालय में CWSN के माता-पिता से संवाद स्थापित करने की जिम्मेदारी केवल विशेष शिक्षक की नहीं होती। चूँकि बच्चा सामान्य कक्षा में नियमित शिक्षकों के मार्गदर्शन में अधिक समय बिताता है, इसलिए सामान्य शिक्षकों को भी अभिभावकों से निरंतर संवाद करना चाहिए। कारण (R) सही है: समावेशी शिक्षा एक सहयोगात्मक टीम दृष्टिकोण पर टिकी है, जहाँ सामान्य शिक्षक और विशेष शिक्षक दोनों मिलकर अभिभावकों के साथ बच्चे की प्रगति, चुनौतियों और IEP के लक्ष्यों पर चर्चा करते हैं। अतः A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In an inclusive school setting, communicating with parents of CWSN is a shared responsibility between general educators and special educators. Inclusive education relies on a collaborative model where both professionals jointly share progress, discuss learning strategies, and engage families, ensuring that the student’s academic and social development is supported coherently.

अघोषित, अलिखित सीख और सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक मूल्य जो प्रभावी पृष्ठभूमि के समूहों को लाभ पहुँचाते हैं

question_english: When addressing socio-economic diversity, the concept of the “Hidden Curriculum” often creates barriers for marginalized students. The hidden curriculum refers to:
options_english: The official examination syllabus which is maintained strictly confidential by school administrators until formal term commencement
Unofficial, unwritten lessons and socio-cultural values that tend to privilege dominant background groups
Specialized enrichment topics and advanced academic electives offered exclusively to highly gifted students during after-school sessions
The internal fiscal rules, accounting procedures, and administrative guidelines governing overall annual institutional expenditure
explanation_english: The 'Hidden Curriculum' refers to the implicit, unwritten, and unstated lessons, behavioural norms, and socio-cultural values transmitted within educational institutions outside of the formal academic syllabus. In socio-economically diverse schools, the hidden curriculum often mirrors the cultural capital, linguistic conventions, and behavioral mannerisms of dominant social groups. Marginalized or disadvantaged students who lack familiarity with these unwritten middle-class expectations may face inadvertent alienation, misunderstandings, and academic disadvantages.
explanation_hindi: 'प्रच्छन्न पाठ्यचर्या' (Hidden Curriculum) से आशय उन अलिखित, अनौपचारिक और अंतर्निहित सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक मूल्यों, मान्यताओं और व्यवहार संबंधी अपेक्षाओं से है जो औपचारिक पाठ्यपुस्तकों के बाहर विद्यालय परिवेश में संचारित होते हैं। विविधतापूर्ण कक्षाओं में यह प्रच्छन्न पाठ्यचर्या प्रायः समाज के प्रभावशाली या उच्च वर्ग की संस्कृति, भाषा और व्यवहार को प्राथमिकता देती है। इससे वंचित और हाशिए के बच्चे, जो इन अलिखित नियमों से परिचित नहीं होते, अदृश्य सामाजिक और शैक्षणिक बाधाओं का सामना करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Unofficial, unwritten lessons and socio-cultural values that tend to privilege dominant background groups

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The hidden curriculum refers to implicit, unwritten socio-cultural values, behavioral expectations, and informal norms transmitted within school environments. In socio-economically diverse classrooms, the hidden curriculum can create subtle academic and social barriers for marginalized students if institutional norms favor the cultural capital, communication styles, and experiences of dominant social groups.

question_english: Which of the following is a proactive strategy to mitigate the impact of the “Digital Divide” among students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds in a school?
options_english: Mandating that all daily homework assignments across subjects must be typed digitally and submitted strictly through electronic mail
Systematically penalizing students with lower academic grades whenever they submit traditional handwritten paper assignments for evaluation
Granting after-hours computer lab access and loaning devices or internet hotspots to students in need
Presuming universal smartphone ownership among all student households and adopting exclusive app-based homework platforms
explanation_english: Bridging the digital divide among economically diverse students requires equitable institutional accommodations. Providing extended access to the school computer laboratory after regular hours, instituting a device-loaning program, and providing portable internet hotspots ensure that students from lower socio-economic backgrounds gain equal access to digital learning tools, research platforms, and technology required for academic assignments.
explanation_hindi: आर्थिक रूप से विविधतापूर्ण कक्षाओं में डिजिटल विभाजन (Digital Divide) को पाटने के लिए सक्रिय संस्थागत सहयोग की आवश्यकता होती है। विद्यालय समय के बाद कंप्यूटर लैब को खुला रखना तथा जरूरतमंद विद्यार्थियों को लैपटॉप, टैबलेट या इंटरनेट डोंगल/हॉटस्पॉट उधार देना यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि वंचित पृष्ठभूमि के छात्रों को भी तकनीकी संसाधनों और डिजिटल अधिगम सामग्री तक समान पहुँच प्राप्त हो सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Granting after-hours computer lab access and loaning devices or internet hotspots to students in need

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Bridging the digital divide among socio-economically diverse students requires proactive institutional support. Providing extended access to school computer facilities after standard hours, loaning digital hardware devices, and offering portable internet hotspots ensure that underprivileged students gain equitable access to technology and digital learning resources necessary for modern academic success.

question_english: Cultural responsiveness in an educational setting involves:
options_english: Viewing linguistic diversity as a deficit that needs to be corrected quickly
Standardizing teaching methods so every child, regardless of background, learns in exactly the same way
Celebrating “Culture Day” once a year while ignoring cultural contexts in daily lessons
Recognizing, respecting, and utilizing students’ cultural references in all aspects of learning
explanation_english: Culturally responsive teaching (CRT) involves acknowledging, valuing, and purposefully integrating students' diverse cultural backgrounds, home languages, and lived experiences into daily pedagogy and classroom interactions. Rather than viewing cultural and linguistic differences through a deficit lens or limiting diversity to tokenistic annual celebrations, culturally responsive educators treat diversity as a rich cognitive asset, thereby fostering student engagement, self-efficacy, and academic success.
explanation_hindi: सांस्कृतिक रूप से उत्तरदायी शिक्षण (Cultural Responsiveness) का आशय विद्यार्थियों की विविध सांस्कृतिक पृष्ठभूमि, मातृभाषा और जीवन अनुभवों को शिक्षण प्रक्रिया में सम्मानपूर्वक एकीकृत करना है। यह दृष्टिकोण सांस्कृतिक विविधता को किसी कमी (Deficit) के रूप में देखने या केवल वर्ष में एक दिन उत्सव मनाने के बजाय, उसे कक्षा में सीखने की एक अमूल्य संपदा मानता है और दैनिक शिक्षण रणनीतियों में विद्यार्थियों के सांस्कृतिक संदर्भों का सक्रिय उपयोग करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Recognizing, respecting, and utilizing students’ cultural references in all aspects of learning

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Cultural responsiveness in education involves actively recognizing, respecting, and incorporating students’ diverse cultural backgrounds, native languages, and lived experiences into everyday teaching strategies and classroom practices. This approach validates student identities, enhances learning engagement, and creates a supportive classroom culture where cultural diversity is viewed as an asset.

question_english:
Consider the following actions by a teacher:
I. Correcting a student’s regional dialect aggressively in front of the class to enforce standard language.
II. Encouraging students to share folk tales from their native regions during literature classes.
III. Designing history lessons that include multiple perspectives, not just the dominant narrative.
Which of these actions demonstrate cultural inclusivity?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III
I, II and III
explanation_english: Actions II and III exemplify cultural inclusivity. Incorporating regional folklore and oral histories acknowledges students' cultural heritages and makes literature classes relatable and diverse. Designing history curricula that present multiple socio-cultural perspectives challenges monolithic historical narratives and promotes critical empathy. In contrast, Action I is culturally exclusive and pedagogically harmful: aggressively correcting a learner's dialect in front of peers invalidates their home culture, causes linguistic insecurity, and alienates them from the classroom community.
explanation_hindi: कार्य II और III सांस्कृतिक समावेशिता (Cultural Inclusivity) को प्रदर्शित करते हैं। साहित्य की कक्षाओं में क्षेत्रीय लोककथाओं को शामिल करना विद्यार्थियों की सांस्कृतिक पृष्ठभूमि का सम्मान करता है और उनकी भाषाई पहचान को मान्यता देता है। इतिहास में विविध दृष्टिकोणों को शामिल करना बहुसांस्कृतिक समझ और आलोचनात्मक चिंतन को बढ़ावा देता है। इसके विपरीत, कक्षा के सामने किसी बच्चे की क्षेत्रीय बोली को आक्रामक रूप से टोकना (कार्य I) उसमें हीनभावना और भाषाई असुरक्षा पैदा करता है, जो समावेशी शिक्षा के सिद्धांतों के विरुद्ध है। अतः केवल II और III सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Encouraging students to share regional folklore and designing history curricula that present diverse cultural perspectives promote cultural inclusivity. Aggressively correcting regional dialects in front of peers invalidates student identity and causes linguistic insecurity; inclusive teachers validate home language dialects while gradually building standard language competencies supportively.

question_english: Gender sensitivity in curriculum transaction requires teachers to be aware of:
options_english: Innate neuro-biological differences in mathematical and verbal intelligence existing between male and female students
Biases in textbook illustrations, teacher questioning patterns, and gender expectations
Guidance directives aimed at steering female students into home science and male students into advanced physical sciences
Mandatory institutional policies requiring absolute physical separation of genders during all athletic and physical education sessions
explanation_english: Gender sensitivity in curriculum delivery requires educators to actively detect, challenge, and eliminate gender stereotyping in classrooms. This includes maintaining critical awareness of gender-biased textbook depictions (e.g., depicting women only in domestic chores and men in leadership or technical roles), avoiding skewed questioning patterns (e.g., asking male students complex analytical questions while giving female students simple recall questions), and dismantling gendered career expectations.
explanation_hindi: पाठ्यचर्या संपादन में लैंगिक संवेदनशीलता (Gender Sensitivity) के लिए शिक्षकों को कक्षा के भीतर और शिक्षण सामग्री में मौजूद सूक्ष्म लैंगिक पूर्वाग्रहों के प्रति निरंतर सचेत रहना चाहिए। इसमें पाठ्यपुस्तकों के चित्रों में रूढ़िवादिता (जैसे महिलाओं को केवल रसोई या देखभाल से जुड़े कार्यों में और पुरुषों को साहसिक व वैज्ञानिक कार्यों में दिखाना), कक्षा में प्रश्न पूछते समय लड़कों और लड़कियों के साथ अलग-अलग व्यवहार करना, और लैंगिक आधार पर पूर्वग्रहयुक्त अपेक्षाएं रखना शामिल हैं। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Biases in textbook illustrations, teacher questioning patterns, and gender expectations

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Gender sensitivity in curriculum transaction requires teachers to maintain critical awareness of gender biases embedded in textbooks, instructional illustrations, and classroom interactions. Teachers must ensure equitable questioning patterns, dismantle traditional gender role expectations, and encourage equal participation of all genders across all academic subjects and co-curricular activities.

question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में अंकित किया गया है।
अभिकथन (A): सभी विद्यार्थियों को बिल्कुल समान भौतिक सुविधाएं प्रदान कर देने से विद्यालय में लैंगिक समता स्वतः सुनिश्चित हो जाती है।
कारण (R): लैंगिक समता का संबंध परिणामों में निष्पक्षता सुनिश्चित करने और विशिष्ट बाधाओं को दूर करने से है, जिसके लिए केवल एकसमान प्रावधान के बजाय विभेदित सहयोग (जैसे सैनिटरी पैड डिस्पेंसर प्रदान करना) की आवश्यकता हो सकती है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है
A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Providing identical physical facilities to all students automatically ensures gender equity in a school.
Reason (R): Gender equity involves ensuring fairness in outcomes and addressing specific barriers, which may require differentiated support rather than strict equality of provision (e.g., providing sanitary pad dispensers).
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: Assertion (A) is false: Providing identical physical resources constitutes 'equality' of inputs, but it does not achieve 'equity'. Gender equity is defined by fairness and justice in educational outcomes. Reason (R) is true: Because different genders face distinct biological, physiological, and social realities, achieving equity necessitates tailored, differentiated provisions. For instance, adolescent girls require dedicated, safe sanitation spaces, private disposal mechanisms, and sanitary pad dispensers to attend school regularly without interruption. Without these differentiated supports, simple numerical equality leaves specific systemic barriers unaddressed. Thus, A is false but R is true.
explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है: सभी छात्रों को बिल्कुल समान भौतिक सुविधाएं देना केवल 'समानता' (Equality) है, यह 'लैंगिक समता' (Gender Equity) की गारंटी नहीं देता। कारण (R) सत्य है: समता का तात्पर्य परिणामों की निष्पक्षता और वास्तविक बाधाओं को दूर करने से है। इसके लिए जैविक और सामाजिक आवश्यकताओं के अनुसार विभेदित एवं लक्षित प्रावधान करने पड़ते हैं—जैसे बालिकाओं के लिए निजी व सुरक्षित शौचालय, सैनिटरी पैड वेंडिंग मशीनें और भस्मक (Incinerators) लगाना। इन विशिष्ट व्यवस्थाओं के बिना किशोरियों की अनुपस्थिति और ड्रॉप-आउट दर बढ़ सकती है। अतः A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Providing identical physical facilities does not guarantee gender equity, as gender equity focuses on fairness of outcomes rather than simple uniformity of provision. Achieving equity requires addressing specific, gendered barriers by delivering targeted support and specialized facilities—such as installing sanitary pad dispensers or ensuring secure, private sanitation facilities for female students.

question_english: Giftedness is generally conceptualized by Joseph Renzulli’s Three-Ring Conception, which includes the interaction of three basic clusters of human traits. These are:
options_english: Above-average ability, high task commitment, and high creativity
Exceptional general intelligence quotient, introverted personality traits, and divergent artistic creativity
Superior long-term memory retention, rapid cognitive processing speed, and high behavioral compliance
Outstanding athletic capability, top-tier academic performance excellence, and natural artistic talent
explanation_english: Joseph Renzulli’s renowned Three-Ring Conception of Giftedness defines gifted behavior as the intersection and dynamic interaction of three core human trait clusters: (1) Above-Average Ability (general or domain-specific intellectual capacity), (2) High Task Commitment (energy, intrinsic motivation, endurance, and perseverance applied to a particular area of endeavor), and (3) High Creativity (originality of ideas, curiosity, and openness to innovation). Renzulli emphasized that giftedness is not solely an extraordinary psychometric IQ score, but rather the synergistic application of these three trait clusters to a significant human problem or performance area.
explanation_hindi: जोसेफ रेंज़ुली (Joseph Renzulli) की 'थ्री-रिंग संकल्पना' (Three-Ring Conception of Giftedness) के अनुसार, प्रतिभाशाली व्यवहार मानवीय विशेषताओं के तीन प्रमुख समूहों के संगम और अंतःक्रिया से उत्पन्न होता है: 1. औसत से अधिक क्षमता (Above-average ability), 2. उच्च कार्य प्रतिबद्धता (High task commitment - अर्थात दृढ़ता, आंतरिक लगन और समर्पण), तथा 3. उच्च सृजनात्मकता (High creativity - अर्थात मौलिकता और नवीन चिंतन)। रेंज़ुली ने स्पष्ट किया कि प्रतिभा केवल उच्च बुद्धिलब्धि (IQ) तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि जब ये तीनों शीलगुण एक साथ मिलकर किसी कार्य पर लागू होते हैं, तब वास्तविक मेधा या उत्कृष्ट व्यवहार प्रकट होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Above-average ability, high task commitment, and high creativity

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Joseph Renzulli’s Three-Ring Conception defines giftedness as the interaction among three fundamental clusters of human traits: above-average intellectual ability, high levels of task commitment (motivation and perseverance), and high levels of creativity. Individuals who possess and apply this combination of traits to specific performance areas display gifted behavior.

question_english: A teacher identifies a student who excels in mathematical reasoning but struggles significantly with reading and writing. This student is best described as:
options_english: Mildly intellectually disabled requiring continuous adaptive support
Having Attention Deficit Disorder without hyperactive behavioral symptoms
Twice-exceptional (2e) - gifted with a learning disability
An underachiever struggling solely due to insufficient academic motivation
explanation_english: A student who exhibits exceptional talent or advanced cognitive capability in a domain such as mathematical or spatial reasoning while concurrently experiencing a specific learning disability (such as dyslexia or dysgraphia affecting reading and writing) is categorized as 'Twice-Exceptional' (2e). Twice-exceptional learners require a dual pedagogical approach: curricular enrichment and challenge to nurture their intellectual gifts, combined with evidence-based accommodations, assistive technologies, and remedial scaffolds to support their specific areas of learning difficulty.
explanation_hindi: एक ऐसा विद्यार्थी जो गणितीय तर्क या अमूर्त चिंतन में असाधारण प्रतिभा (Giftedness) दिखाता है, किंतु पठन-लेखन में विशिष्ट अधिगम अक्षमता (जैसे डिस्लेक्सिया या डिस्ग्राफिया) के कारण गंभीर कठिनाई का सामना करता है, उसे शिक्षाशास्त्र में 'द्वि-विशिष्ट' (Twice-Exceptional / 2e) शिक्षार्थी कहा जाता है। ऐसे विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक दोहरी शैक्षणिक रणनीति की आवश्यकता होती है: उनकी उच्च प्रतिभा को पोषित करने के लिए संवर्द्धन एवं बौद्धिक चुनौतियाँ देना, तथा उनकी अधिगम अक्षमता के समाधान हेतु विशेष उपचारात्मक सहयोग और समायोजन प्रदान करना।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Twice-exceptional (2e) - gifted with a learning disability

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A student who demonstrates superior capability in advanced mathematical reasoning alongside marked difficulties in reading and writing mechanics represents a classic profile of a “Twice-Exceptional” (2e) learner. Twice-exceptional students possess high cognitive talent or giftedness in specific areas while simultaneously experiencing one or more learning disabilities.

question_english: Which of the following strategies is an example of “Enrichment” for a gifted learner?
options_english: Accelerating the student by skipping a grade level entirely to join older peers in advanced classes
Assigning fifty additional repetitive math problems of identical difficulty to keep the student occupied
Directing the student to perform routine classroom maintenance tasks while peers complete their assignments
Offering opportunities for independent research projects beyond the standard curriculum
explanation_english: In gifted education, 'Enrichment' refers to broadening, deepening, and enriching the regular curriculum by offering higher-level conceptual challenges, independent investigations, and creative problem-solving projects without advancing the student to a higher grade level. Offering self-directed research inquiries beyond standard textbook requirements allows gifted students to delve deeply into complex topics, fostering analytical thinking and intrinsic engagement. In contrast, skipping a grade level (Option A) represents 'Acceleration', while assigning repetitive drills (Option B) is mere busywork that demotivates gifted minds.
explanation_hindi: प्रतिभाशाली विद्यार्थियों के लिए 'संवर्द्धन' (Enrichment) का तात्पर्य विद्यार्थी को उसकी अपनी कक्षा में रखते हुए पाठ्यक्रम को अधिक व्यापक, गहरा और चुनौतीपूर्ण बनाना है। मानक पाठ्यचर्या से परे जाकर स्वतंत्र शोध परियोजनाओं (Independent research projects), विश्लेषणात्मक कार्यों और गहन अन्वेषण के अवसर देना संवर्द्धन का उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है। इसके विपरीत, पूरी एक कक्षा आगे बढ़ाना (विकल्प A) 'त्वरण' (Acceleration) कहलाता है, जबकि समान कठिनाई के अतिरिक्त प्रश्न देना (विकल्प B) केवल निरर्थक व्यस्त रखने का काम है जिससे मेधावी छात्र हतोत्साहित होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Offering opportunities for independent research projects beyond the standard curriculum

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Enrichment for gifted learners involves broadening and deepening the curriculum without skipping grade levels. Providing opportunities for self-directed independent research projects, complex problem-solving investigations, and higher-order analytical tasks allows gifted students to explore subjects in greater depth, maintaining high cognitive engagement aligned with their advanced capabilities.

question_hindi: प्रकरण परिदृश्य (Case Scenario): एक शिक्षक पूरी कक्षा के लिए एक लिखित निबंध परीक्षा आयोजित करता है। गंभीर डिस्ग्राफिया (Dysgraphia) से पीड़ित एक विद्यार्थी विषय-वस्तु को पूरी तरह जानता है, किंतु परीक्षा में अनुत्तीर्ण हो जाता है क्योंकि उसकी लिखावट अपठनीय है और वह बहुत धीमी गति से लिखता है। प्रधानाचार्य को यहाँ किस समावेशी मूल्यांकन पद्धति को लागू करना चाहिए?

सहानुभूति के आधार पर विद्यार्थी को अतिरिक्त ग्रेस अंक प्रदान करना

question_english: Case Scenario: A teacher gives a written essay exam to the whole class. A student with severe dysgraphia knows the content perfectly but fails the exam because his handwriting is illegible and he writes very slowly. What inclusive assessment practice should the Principal implement here?
options_english: Advise the student to practice handwriting for two hours daily
Give the student grace marks out of sympathy
Allow an oral assessment or use of a scribe/computer
Retain the student in the same class until their handwriting performance improves significantly
explanation_english: Inclusive assessment requires that testing modalities accurately evaluate a learner's conceptual understanding and curricular mastery rather than penalizing their disability. Dysgraphia is a neurological condition impairing fine-motor coordination and writing mechanics. When a written test format acts as a barrier, providing reasonable testing accommodations—such as an oral viva, an amanuensis (scribe), or speech-to-text / computer typing—enables the student to demonstrate their knowledge fairly and equitably without altering content rigor.
explanation_hindi: समावेशी मूल्यांकन का मुख्य उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि परीक्षण विद्यार्थी के वास्तविक ज्ञान और समझ का मूल्यांकन करे, न कि उसकी शारीरिक या स्नायविक अक्षमता का। डिस्ग्राफिया (Dysgraphia) एक विशिष्ट अधिगम विकार है जो सूक्ष्म-क्रियात्मक कौशल और हस्तलेखन को बाधित करता है। जब किसी विद्यार्थी को विषय की पूरी समझ हो किंतु वह लिखने में असमर्थ हो, तो उसे वैकल्पिक माध्यम—जैसे मौखिक परीक्षा, लेखक (स्क्राइब) या कंप्यूटर पर टाइपिंग की सुविधा—प्रदान करना एक मानक समावेशी समायोजन है। इससे बिना शैक्षणिक मानकों से समझौता किए निष्पक्ष मूल्यांकन संभव होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Allow an oral assessment or use of a scribe/computer

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: When a student with dysgraphia understands subject content but cannot demonstrate knowledge through written handwriting, appropriate inclusive assessment requires providing alternative response formats. Allowing an oral examination, providing a scribe, or permitting the use of a computer with text processing tools ensures the assessment accurately measures content mastery rather than fine-motor impairment.

question_hindi: एक समावेशी कक्षा में रचनात्मक / निर्माणात्मक मूल्यांकन (Formative Assessment) का प्राथमिक उपयोग किस लिए किया जाना चाहिए?

कम प्रदर्शन करने वाले विद्यार्थियों की पहचान करके उन्हें समावेशी कक्षाओं से बाहर करने का आधार बनाना

question_english: Formative assessment in an inclusive classroom should primarily be used to:
options_english: Systematically rank and sort students from top academic performers to lowest achievers for reporting
Guide instructional decisions and provide ongoing student feedback
Calculate final summative letter grades and cumulative grade point averages for official transcripts
Screen and identify lower-performing students who ought to be removed from inclusive classrooms
explanation_english: In inclusive education, Formative Assessment ('Assessment FOR Learning') serves a developmental and instructional purpose. Its primary goal is not to grade, sort, or rank learners, but to continuously monitor learning progress, diagnose specific conceptual misunderstandings, and inform ongoing pedagogical adjustments. For students, it provides timely, descriptive feedback that guides self-correction and mastery; for educators, it indicates when instructional strategies, materials, or scaffolding need to be adapted to meet diverse learner needs.
explanation_hindi: समावेशी शिक्षा में रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन (Formative Assessment) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य विद्यार्थियों को रैंक देना या छांटना नहीं, बल्कि शिक्षण-अधिगम प्रक्रिया को निरंतर सुदृढ़ बनाना है। यह मूल्यांकन शिक्षक को यह समझने में सहायता करता है कि शिक्षण विधियों में कहाँ बदलाव की आवश्यकता है और विद्यार्थियों को समय पर उपचारात्मक प्रतिपुष्टि (Ongoing descriptive feedback) प्रदान करता है, जिससे सभी शिक्षार्थी अपनी गति से सीखते हुए निरंतर प्रगति कर सकें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Guide instructional decisions and provide ongoing student feedback

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Formative assessment in inclusive classrooms serves to continuously monitor student progress, diagnose learning gaps, and provide actionable feedback to both teachers and learners. Rather than sorting or ranking students, formative evaluations guide real-time instructional modifications, scaffolding choices, and pedagogical strategies to ensure effective ongoing learning support for all students.

question_english:
Consider the following assessment adaptations:
I. Extending the time limit
II. Changing the font size or using Braille
III. Lowering the passing criteria from 33% to 10%
IV. Providing a quiet distraction-free room
Which of these are considered standard ‘Accommodations’ (not modifications) in examinations for CWSN?
options_english: I, II and III
I, II and IV
II, III and IV
I, III and IV
explanation_english: Standard assessment 'Accommodations' alter the conditions, timing, format, or physical setting of an examination to eliminate disability-related access barriers WITHOUT lowering the academic expectations or changing what the test measures. Extending test time (Item I), using large-print/Braille (Item II), and providing a distraction-free testing environment (Item IV) are classic accommodations. Conversely, lowering the passing score from 33% to 10% (Item III) fundamentally alters the academic performance benchmark, qualifying it as an assessment 'Modification', not an accommodation. Therefore, Items I, II, and IV are correct.
explanation_hindi: समावेशी परीक्षा नीतियों में 'समायोजन' (Accommodations) से तात्पर्य उन परिवर्तनों से है जो परीक्षा के प्रारूप, समय या वातावरण में किए जाते हैं ताकि दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों को परीक्षा में समान पहुँच मिल सके, बिना अधिगम के मानकों या मूल्यांकन के स्तर को बदले। अतिरिक्त समय देना (I), ब्रेल या बड़े फ़ॉन्ट का उपयोग (II), तथा शांत विकर्षण-मुक्त कमरा प्रदान करना (IV) मानक समायोजन हैं। इसके विपरीत, उत्तीर्ण होने के न्यूनतम अंक 33% से घटाकर 10% करना (III) परीक्षा के मूल मानक और प्रदर्शन अपेक्षाओं को कम करता है, इसलिए यह 'संशोधन' (Modification) है, न कि समायोजन। अतः I, II और IV सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Standard exam accommodations alter testing formats or conditions without lowering learning standards; examples include extending time limits, using large print/Braille, and providing quiet testing rooms. Lowering passing score criteria from 33% to 10% fundamentally alters the academic performance benchmark, making it an assessment modification rather than an accommodation.

question_english: Sensitization programs for peers in an inclusive school should emphasize:
options_english: Framing disability as human diversity to promote empathy and collaboration
Portraying students with disabilities as tragic inspirational “superheroes” who courageously overcome insurmountable odds daily
Cultivating traditional feelings of charitable pity, patronizing sympathy, and benevolent welfare toward disabled peers
Instructing non-disabled students to maintain physical distance from CWSN to prevent accidental injury during interactions
explanation_english: Peer sensitization programs in inclusive schools must frame disability as a natural dimension of human diversity, cultivating authentic empathy, equity, and collaborative peer relationships. Inclusive pedagogy explicitly cautions against two damaging stereotypes: the 'Charity Model' (viewing disabled peers as objects of pity or benevolent condescension) and the 'Superhero / Supercrip Trope' (unrealistically portraying persons with disabilities as inspirational superheroes). True inclusion normalizes differences and builds genuine, equal friendships.
explanation_hindi: समावेशी विद्यालय में सहपाठी संवेदीकरण (Peer Sensitization) का मुख्य उद्देश्य दिव्यांगता को मानव विविधता के एक स्वाभाविक और सकारात्मक अंग के रूप में प्रस्तुत करना है। इससे विद्यार्थियों में आपसी संवेदनशीलता, समानता, सम्मान और स्वाभाविक सहयोग की भावना विकसित होती है। संवेदीकरण कार्यक्रमों में दया/दान की भावना (विकल्प C) तथा दिव्यांग बच्चों को 'सुपरहीरो' के रूप में महिमामंडित करने (विकल्प B) से बचना चाहिए, क्योंकि ये दोनों दृष्टिकोण समानता और स्वाभाविक मित्रता में बाधा डालते हैं। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Framing disability as human diversity to promote empathy and collaboration

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Peer sensitization programs should frame disability as a natural dimension of human diversity, cultivating genuine empathy, mutual respect, and collaborative peer relationships. Programs must actively avoid patronizing approaches that frame disabled individuals either as objects of charitable pity or as inspirational “superheroes,” as both tropes reinforce social alienation and inequality.

question_english: Which of the following is an effective method for a teacher to promote positive peer interactions in an inclusive classroom?
options_english: Publicly disclosing the confidential medical diagnosis, psychological reports, and IQ test scores of CWSN during general class assemblies
Designing a fixed classroom seating arrangement that groups all CWSN together in a designated back corner of the room
Establishing a peer “Buddy System” where students volunteer to collaborate with CWSN
Enforcing strict disciplinary sanctions against non-disabled students whenever they inquire about a classmate’s disability
explanation_english: Implementing a peer 'Buddy System' is a proven, evidence-based strategy to foster meaningful social inclusion and collaborative learning. Pairing typically developing student volunteers with peers who have special educational needs encourages mutual support during classroom assignments, lunch breaks, and playground activities. This natural peer scaffolding enhances social competence, decreases isolation, and builds mutual respect without compromising student confidentiality or dignity.
explanation_hindi: कक्षा में एक सहपाठी 'बडी सिस्टम' (Buddy System) स्थापित करना समावेशी वातावरण में सकारात्मक अंतःक्रिया को बढ़ावा देने का एक अत्यंत प्रभावी तरीका है। इसमें सामान्य छात्र स्वेच्छा से दिव्यांग सहपाठियों के 'बडी' (मित्र/सहयोगी) बनते हैं और कक्षा के कार्यों, खेल के मैदान तथा मध्याह्न भोजन के दौरान एक-दूसरे का सहयोग करते हैं। यह व्यवस्था दिव्यांग बच्चों के सामाजिक अलगाव को दूर करती है और सभी विद्यार्थियों में सहयोग एवं संवेदनशीलता की भावना का विकास करती है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Establishing a peer “Buddy System” is an effective strategy for promoting positive peer relationships in inclusive schools. question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The NEP 2020 recommends establishing a “Bal Bhavan” in every state/district to support students with diverse needs.
Reason (R): Bal Bhavans are intended to provide a specialized boarding facility specifically for children with severe disabilities to keep them away from mainstream schools.

options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false

explanation_english: Assertion (A) is true: The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 explicitly advocates strengthening and establishing 'Bal Bhavans' in every state, district, and school complex as vibrant daytime learning centers where children can participate in creative, artistic, sports, and play-based enrichment activities. Reason (R) is false: Bal Bhavans are non-formal day enrichment centers open to ALL children regardless of background or ability; they are fundamentally NOT segregated residential boarding schools designed to isolate children with disabilities from mainstream schools. Therefore, Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 प्रत्येक राज्य, जिले और स्कूल कॉम्प्लेक्स में 'बाल भवन' स्थापित करने की सिफारिश करती है, जहाँ बच्चे सप्ताहांत या स्कूल के बाद कला, संगीत, खेल और रचनात्मक गतिविधियों में भाग ले सकें। कारण (R) असत्य है: बाल भवन कोई अलग-थलग आवासीय संस्थान (Segregated boarding facility) नहीं हैं और न ही इनका उद्देश्य दिव्यांग बच्चों को मुख्यधारा के विद्यालयों से अलग करना है। इसके विपरीत, ये सभी बच्चों के लिए खुले समावेशी और आनंददायक शिक्षण केंद्र हैं। अतः A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The National Education Policy 2020 advocates establishing “Bal Bhavans” in every state and district as vibrant learning centers. question_english: Under the PM SHRI (Prime Minister Schools for Rising India) initiative, which of the following represents a primary focus area concerning inclusive education?
options_english: Establishing segregated campus facilities specifically dedicated to boys, girls, and CWSN populations
Creating barrier-free physical infrastructure and fostering gender-equitable, inclusive learning environments
Gradually phasing out specialized support personnel to reduce ongoing institutional operational expenditure
Restricting school enrollment and admission criteria strictly to academically gifted and talented candidates
explanation_english: Under the PM SHRI (Pradhan Mantri Schools for Rising India) initiative, existing government and local body schools are upgraded to serve as exemplar institutions showcasing the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. A core pillar of PM SHRI is inclusive and equitable education. Key interventions mandated under the scheme include: (1) Developing 100% barrier-free physical infrastructure (such as ramps with handrails, accessible disabled-friendly toilets, tactile pathways, and Braille-enabled signage); (2) Providing accessible digital devices and assistive technologies; (3) Promoting gender equity through safe school environments and self-defense training; and (4) Fostering a welcoming, stigma-free climate for Children with Special Needs (CWSN) and socially disadvantaged groups. Segregation (Option A), cutting support staff (Option C), and elite admissions (Option D) directly contradict the inclusive mandate of PM SHRI and NEP 2020.
explanation_hindi: पीएम श्री (प्रधानमंत्री स्कूल्स फॉर राइजिंग इंडिया) योजना राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 की परिकल्पना को धरातल पर उतारने वाले अनुकरणीय (मॉडल) विद्यालयों के विकास की केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना है। समावेशी और समतामूलक शिक्षा इस योजना का एक आधारभूत स्तंभ है। योजना के दिशा-निर्देशों के तहत प्रमुख प्राथमिकताओं में शामिल हैं: (1) शत-प्रतिशत बाधा-मुक्त भौतिक अवसंरचना तैयार करना (जैसे मानक ढलान वाले रैंप, दिव्यांग-अनुकूल शौचालय, ब्रेल साइनेज और स्पर्श पथ); (2) सुलभ डिजिटल तकनीकें और सहायक उपकरण उपलब्ध कराना; (3) लैंगिक समता और बालिकाओं के लिए सुरक्षित शिक्षण परिवेश का निर्माण करना; तथा (4) विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों (CWSN) और सामाजिक-आर्थिक रूप से वंचित समूहों के लिए एक समावेशी व स्वागतयोग्य माहौल तैयार करना। विकल्प A (अलग परिसर बनाना), विकल्प C (सहयोगी कर्मचारियों को हटाना) और विकल्प D (केवल मेधावी बच्चों का चयन) समावेशी शिक्षा के संवैधानिक और नीतिगत सिद्धांतों के पूर्णतः विपरीत हैं।

question_english: Which of the following scholarship schemes are specifically designed to provide financial support to students with disabilities pursuing higher education in India?
options_english: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
Pragati Scholarship Scheme
Saksham Scholarship Scheme
Both (A) and (C)
explanation_english:
The Government of India implements targeted financial assistance schemes to enhance higher education access for students with disabilities: 
1. Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities: Administered by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. It covers students with benchmark disabilities (40% or more) studying from Class 11 up to post-graduate and doctoral levels, providing maintenance allowances, book grants, and disability allowances. 
2. Saksham Scholarship Scheme: Administered by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education. It provides financial support of ₹50,000 per annum to differently-abled students pursuing technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions. 
In contrast, the Pragati Scholarship Scheme (Option B) is an AICTE initiative exclusively for meritorious girl students entering technical education, regardless of disability. Therefore, both (A) and (C) specifically support disabled students in higher education, making Option D the correct answer.
explanation_hindi:
भारत सरकार दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों को उच्च एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा प्राप्त करने में सक्षम बनाने हेतु कई विशिष्ट छात्रवृत्ति योजनाएं संचालित करती है:
1. दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities): यह योजना सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता मंत्रालय के दिव्यांगजन सशक्तिकरण विभाग (DEPwD) द्वारा संचालित है। यह कक्षा 11 से लेकर स्नातकोत्तर व डॉक्टरेट स्तर तक के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले विद्यार्थियों को रखरखाव भत्ता, पुस्तक अनुदान और दिव्यांगता भत्ता प्रदान करती है।
2. सक्षम छात्रवृत्ति योजना (Saksham Scholarship Scheme): यह शिक्षा मंत्रालय के अधीन अखिल भारतीय तकनीकी शिक्षा परिषद (AICTE) द्वारा तकनीकी शिक्षा (डिग्री एवं डिप्लोमा) में प्रवेश लेने वाले विशेष रूप से सक्षम (दिव्यांग) विद्यार्थियों को प्रति वर्ष ₹50,000 की वित्तीय सहायता देती है।
विकल्प B में दी गई 'प्रगति छात्रवृत्ति' (Pragati Scholarship) AICTE द्वारा केवल बालिकाओं को तकनीकी शिक्षा हेतु प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए है, न कि दिव्यांगता के आधार पर। अतः (A) और (C) दोनों ही दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों के लिए समर्पित योजनाएं हैं, जिससे विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Both (A) and (C)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Government of India provides dedicated financial support for students with disabilities pursuing higher education through schemes such as the Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities and the Saksham Scholarship Scheme (administered by AICTE for technical education). Both schemes assist eligible disabled students in covering educational fees and maintenance allowances.

question_english: A teacher employs “Peer-Mediated Instruction and Intervention” (PMII) in an inclusive classroom. This evidence-based pedagogical strategy primarily involves:
options_english: Utilizing interactive computer software programs and digital platforms to mediate individual academic learning
Inviting parent volunteers to deliver specialized instructional lessons to the class on a weekly rotating schedule
Establishing formal administrative mediation procedures led by the Principal to resolve interpersonal teacher-student conflicts
Training peers to serve as instructional models, tutors, and social partners for CWSN under teacher guidance
explanation_english: Peer-Mediated Instruction and Intervention (PMII) is an empirically validated, evidence-based inclusive pedagogical strategy where general education peers are systematically trained to act as instructional agents, social buddies, and behavioral models for Children with Special Needs (CWSN). Under the supervision and planning of the teacher or special educator, trained peers initiate social interactions, model appropriate communication and play, prompt academic responses, and provide structured peer tutoring. PMII has demonstrated exceptional efficacy in improving social, linguistic, and scholastic outcomes for students with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ADHD, and intellectual disabilities within least restrictive regular classroom environments. Options A, B, and C describe computer-assisted learning, parental involvement, and administrative conflict resolution, none of which constitute PMII.
explanation_hindi: सहकर्मी-मध्यस्थता युक्त शिक्षण और हस्तक्षेप (PMII - Peer-Mediated Instruction and Intervention) एक साक्ष्य-आधारित शैक्षणिक रणनीति है, जिसका व्यापक उपयोग समावेशी कक्षाओं में विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों (विशेष रूप से ऑटिज्म स्पेक्ट्रम विकार, बौद्धिक अक्षमता और ध्यानाभाव वाले छात्रों) के लिए किया जाता है। इस रणनीति में, कक्षा शिक्षक सामान्य (गैर-दिव्यांग) सहपाठियों को इस प्रकार प्रशिक्षित करता है कि वे CWSN विद्यार्थियों के साथ सकारात्मक बातचीत शुरू कर सकें, उपयुक्त व्यवहार और संचार का प्रदर्शन (Model) कर सकें, और शैक्षणिक कार्यों में छोटे शिक्षक (Peer Tutor) या सहयोगी के रूप में सहायता कर सकें। यह प्रक्रिया शिक्षक के प्रत्यक्ष मार्गदर्शन में चलती है। यह उपागम समावेशी वातावरण में प्राकृतिक मित्रता, सामाजिक कौशल और सीखने की गति को गति प्रदान करता है। विकल्प A कंप्यूटर-सहायक अधिगम है, B अभिभावक सहभागिता है, और C प्रशासनिक विवाद प्रबंधन है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Training peers to serve as instructional models and helpers for CWSN under teacher guidance

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: models and helpers for CWSN under teacher guidance Peer-Mediated Instruction and Intervention (PMII) is an evidence-based strategy where teachers systematically train non-disabled peers to act as tutors, instructional models, and social partners for students with special needs. Under teacher supervision, peer mediators assist CWSN in learning academic, communication, and social skills within regular classroom settings.

question_hindi: प्रकरण परिदृश्य (Case Scenario): एक समावेशी कक्षा में, एक दृष्टिबाधित छात्रा मध्यांतर (Recess) के दौरान अलग-थलग महसूस करती है क्योंकि अन्य सहपाठी उसके साथ खेलने या बातचीत करने से झिझकते हैं। प्रधानाचार्य विद्यालय में एक वास्तविक समावेशी संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देना चाहते हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा हस्तक्षेप सबसे उपयुक्त और प्रभावी होगा?
options_hindi: सहज सहकर्मी अंतःक्रिया और संवेदनशीलता विकसित करने के लिए संरचित सहकारी खेल और दिव्यांगता जागरूकता कार्यशालाएं आयोजित करना

question_english: Case Scenario: In a mixed-ability inclusive classroom, a visually impaired student feels socially isolated during recess because peers avoid interacting with her due to hesitation and awkwardness. The Principal seeks to cultivate an authentic inclusive school culture. Which intervention is most pedagogically and socially appropriate?
options_english: Organize cooperative games and disability awareness workshops to build natural peer interactions and empathy
Designate a restricted, protected playground zone reserved exclusively for the visually impaired student during recess periods
Mandate a rotating group of classmates to accompany the student, threatening formal detention if they decline
Instruct the visually impaired student to remain inside the quiet school library throughout all recess breaks for safety
explanation_english: Genuine inclusive education extends far beyond shared physical presence during academic lectures to encompass full social and emotional participation during unstructured times like recess. When peers avoid interacting with a visually impaired student, it is almost invariably caused by unfamiliarity, misconception, or fear of causing accidental harm, rather than malice. The most effective administrative intervention is proactive, educational, and voluntary (Option A): conducting interactive disability sensitization workshops demystifies visual impairment and teaches peers how to communicate and guide appropriately. Concurrently, organizing structured cooperative games (e.g., sound-ball games, circle games, audio-guided activities) provides equal, fun platforms where peer interactions and organic friendships flourish naturally. In contrast, Option B enforces segregation, Option C creates resentment through coercion, and Option D isolates the child further under the pretext of safety.
explanation_hindi: वास्तविक समावेशन केवल कक्षा के भीतर एक साथ बैठने तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि मध्यांतर (Recess) और खेलकूद जैसी अनौपचारिक गतिविधियों में संवेगात्मक और सामाजिक सहभागिता सुनिश्चित करना इसका अनिवार्य अंग है। दृष्टिबाधित सहपाठी से दूरी बनाने का मुख्य कारण द्वेष न होकर झिझक, अज्ञानता और यह न जानना होता है कि दृष्टिबाधित बच्चे के साथ कैसे संवाद या खेल किया जाए। प्रधानाचार्य के लिए सबसे प्रभावी कदम विकल्प A है: दिव्यांगता संवेदीकरण कार्यशालाएं विद्यार्थियों के मन से भ्रांतियों को दूर करती हैं और उन्हें मार्गदर्शन के सही तरीके सिखाती हैं। इसके साथ ही सहकारी खेलों (जैसे घंटी वाली गेंद के खेल, स्पर्शनीय खेल) का आयोजन दोनों पक्षों को एक समान धरातल पर लाता है जिससे प्राकृतिक और सहज मित्रता पनपती है। विकल्प B छात्रा को मैदान में अलग-थलग (Segregate) करता है। विकल्प C जबरन आदेश थोपता है जिससे दुर्भावना पैदा होती है। विकल्प D सुरक्षा के नाम पर बच्चे के सामाजिक विकास के अधिकार का हनन करता है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Organize cooperative games and disability awareness workshops to build natural peer interactions

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: awareness workshops to build natural peer interactions To address social isolation during recess, school leadership should implement inclusive school- wide strategies, such as organizing cooperative playground games and structured disability awareness workshops. These activities foster genuine empathy, break down peer hesitation, and build natural, voluntary social interactions between visually impaired students and their non-disabled classmates.

I. समावेशन का तात्पर्य केवल विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों (CWSN) को मुख्यधारा की सामान्य कक्षा में भौतिक रूप से बैठाना है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?

केवल II और III

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the concept and philosophy of inclusion:
I. Inclusion is merely the physical placement of Children with Special Needs (CWSN) into a mainstream classroom.
II. Authentic inclusion requires systemic reforms across pedagogy, curriculum, learning resources, and assessment.
III. Inclusive education is designed to benefit both disabled and non-disabled students.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
explanation_english:
In modern educational theory, 'integration' and 'inclusion' represent distinct paradigms: 
- Statement I is incorrect: Simply placing a child with special needs into a conventional classroom without modifying instruction, attitudes, or environments constitutes mere physical placement or 'integration'. It places the burden of adaptation entirely on the child. 
- Statement II is correct: Authentic 'inclusion' requires systemic transformation of the entire educational apparatus—restructuring pedagogy (differentiated instruction), creating flexible curricula, providing assistive technologies, adapting physical spaces, and reforming assessments so that the system accommodates the diverse needs of every learner. 
- Statement III is correct: Inclusion adopts a non-deficit model that enriches the learning environment for all students. Non-disabled students gain empathy, social responsibility, collaborative problem-solving skills, and cognitive flexibility when exposed to multi-modal universal design principles. Therefore, statements II and III are correct.
explanation_hindi:
आधुनिक शिक्षाशास्त्र में 'एकीकरण' (Integration) और 'समावेशन' (Inclusion) में स्पष्ट अंतर है:
- कथन I असत्य है: विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चे को बिना किसी शैक्षणिक, पाठ्यचर्या या भौतिक अनुकूलन के सामान्य कक्षा में बैठा देना मात्र 'एकीकरण' या भौतिक उपस्थिति है, वास्तविक समावेशन नहीं। इसमें बच्चे से व्यवस्था के अनुरूप ढलने की अपेक्षा की जाती है।
- कथन II सत्य है: वास्तविक 'समावेशन' पूरी शैक्षणिक व्यवस्था में आमूलचूल सुधार की मांग करता है। इसमें शिक्षण विधियों (विभेदित शिक्षण), लचीले पाठ्यक्रम, सहायक तकनीकों और बहु-आयामी मूल्यांकन प्रणालियों में व्यवस्थागत बदलाव किए जाते हैं ताकि व्यवस्था बच्चे की जरूरतों के अनुरूप ढल सके।
- कथन III सत्य है: समावेशी शिक्षा का लाभ सभी विद्यार्थियों को मिलता है। गैर-दिव्यांग बच्चे भी विविधता का सम्मान करना, सहानुभूति, सहयोग और विभिन्न तरीकों से सोचना व सीखना सीखते हैं। अतः कथन II और III दोनों सही हैं, जिससे विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Inclusion is not merely physical placement in a regular classroom, which constitutes integration. True inclusion requires comprehensive systemic reform in pedagogical methods, curricula, and assessment procedures. Furthermore, inclusive practices benefit all learners—both disabled and non-disabled—by cultivating collaborative skills, diverse learning pathways, and socio-emotional empathy.

options_hindi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमाओं के पार एक समान सौंदर्यपरक लेआउट के अनुसार विद्यालय भवनों का निर्माण करना

question_english: According to Section 2(ze) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016, “Universal Design” is legally defined as:
options_english: Constructing architectural school buildings following standardized aesthetic layouts uniformly across international borders
Designing products, environments, programmes, and services to be usable by all people, to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaptation or specialized design
Drafting global educational governance framework policies mandated directly by United Nations international committees
Administering standardized clinical treatment and rehabilitation protocols universally to all registered individuals with sensory or physical impairments
explanation_english: Section 2(ze) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 statutorily defines Universal Design as: 'the design of products, environments, programmes and services to be usable by all people, to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaptation or specialised design, but shall not exclude assistive devices for particular groups of persons with disabilities where this is needed.' In education, universal design embodies two dimensions: (1) Built environment accessibility (ramps, curb cuts, accessible doors, lever handles) usable by everyone regardless of physical ability; and (2) Universal Design for Learning (UDL), which structures curriculum, digital textbooks, and teaching methods with multiple means of engagement, representation, and action/expression. Options A, C, and D are factually inaccurate and distort the statutory definition.
explanation_hindi: दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम, 2016 (RPwD Act) की धारा 2(ze) में 'सार्वभौमिक डिजाइन' (Universal Design) को कानूनी रूप से परिभाषित किया गया है। इसके अनुसार, इसका तात्पर्य उत्पादों, परिवेशों, कार्यक्रमों और सेवाओं के ऐसे डिजाइन से है जो किसी अनुकूलन या विशिष्ट पुनः-डिजाइन की आवश्यकता के बिना, अधिकतम संभव सीमा तक सभी लोगों द्वारा उपयोग किए जा सकें (यद्यपि इसमें आवश्यकतानुसार दिव्यांगजनों के लिए विशिष्ट सहायक उपकरणों को बाहर नहीं किया गया है)। शिक्षा में, इसका अर्थ भौतिक सुगम्यता (जैसे बिना सीढ़ियों के सुगम रैंप, चौड़े दरवाजे) और शैक्षणिक सुगम्यता (यूनिवर्सल डिजाइन फॉर लर्निंग - UDL) दोनों से है, जिससे सभी बच्चे अपनी व्यक्तिगत क्षमताओं के अनुसार सीख सकें। विकल्प A, C और D अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के विपरीत और अप्रासंगिक हैं। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Designing products, environments, and services usable by all people without adaptation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: services usable by all people without adaptation Section 2(ze) of the RPwD Act, 2016 defines “Universal Design” as the design of products, environments, programs, and services to be usable by all people, to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaptation or specialized redesign, thereby ensuring seamless accessibility across educational and public spaces.

question_hindi: निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 (2012 में यथा-संशोधित) के अंतर्गत, गंभीर दिव्यांगता और बहु-दिव्यांगता वाले बच्चों को निम्नलिखित में से किसका विकल्प चुनने का विधिक अधिकार प्राप्त है?
options_hindi: गृह-आधारित शिक्षा (Home-based education)

question_english: Under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 (as amended in 2012), children with multiple disabilities and severe disabilities have the explicit legal right to opt for:
options_english: Home-based education with specialized instructional support
Complete statutory exemption from receiving any form of education
Gainful employment and vocational labor in lieu of schooling
State-funded education in foreign specialized educational institutions
explanation_english: Through the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (Amendment) Act, 2012, a specific proviso was inserted into Section 3 of the RTE Act, 2009. The amendment statutorily recognized that while neighborhood inclusive schools remain the primary right, a child with multiple disabilities or severe disabilities who cannot physically attend school may opt for home-based education. Under the Samagra Shiksha framework, home-based education provides regular visits by itinerant special educators, customized learning resources, physical/occupational therapy support, parent counseling, and periodic evaluations directly at the child’s home. Options B and C violate fundamental rights under Article 21A and child protection laws. Option D is fictitious. Therefore, Option A is the correct answer.
explanation_hindi: शिक्षा का अधिकार (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2012 के माध्यम से RTE अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 3 में एक महत्वपूर्ण परंतुक (proviso) जोड़ा गया था। इसके तहत यह प्रावधान किया गया कि बहु-दिव्यांगता (Multiple Disabilities) अथवा गंभीर दिव्यांगता (Severe Disabilities) से ग्रसित बच्चे, जो गंभीर स्वास्थ्य या गामक कारणों से सामान्य विद्यालय में आने में असमर्थ हैं, 'गृह-आधारित शिक्षा' (Home-based Education) का विकल्प चुन सकते हैं। समग्र शिक्षा अभियान के तहत ऐसे विद्यार्थियों के लिए भ्रमणशील विशेष शिक्षकों (Itinerant Special Educators), फिजियोथेरेपिस्ट, सुलभ शिक्षण सामग्री और अभिभावक परामर्श की व्यवस्था सीधे उनके घर पर की जाती है। विकल्प B (शिक्षा से छूट) संविधान के अनुच्छेद 21A के विरुद्ध है, तथा विकल्प C (रोजगार) बाल श्रम कानून का उल्लंघन है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Home-based education

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the Right to Education Act, 2009 (as amended) and the RPwD Act, 2016, children with severe or multiple disabilities who cannot attend regular neighborhood schools have the explicit statutory right to opt for home-based education, receiving specialized educational support and learning resources delivered directly to their residences.

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Dyslexia is characterized primarily by poor reading comprehension despite adequate decoding and accurate word recognition skills.
Reason (R): Dyslexia is a neurobiological, language-based specific learning disability that mainly affects the phonological processing of words.
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: Assertion (A) is completely false, whereas Reason (R) is true. According to the International Dyslexia Association (IDA) and diagnostic clinical manuals (DSM-5 / ICD-11), Dyslexia is a neurobiological, language-based specific learning disability. It is characterized primarily by difficulties with accurate and/or fluent word recognition, poor phonological decoding, and poor spelling. The core deficit lies in the phonological component of language processing, as correctly stated in Reason (R). Because children with dyslexia struggle immensely with the mechanical, bottom-up task of decoding printed symbols into phonemes, their cognitive working memory becomes overwhelmed, leading to reading comprehension difficulties as a secondary consequence. If a student demonstrates adequate decoding and word recognition but has poor reading comprehension, the clinical condition is termed 'Specific Reading Comprehension Deficit' or 'Hyperlexia', not dyslexia. Therefore, Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.
explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) पूरी तरह से असत्य है, जबकि कारण (R) सत्य है। इंटरनेशनल डिस्लेक्सिया एसोसिएशन (IDA) और DSM-5 के अनुसार, डिस्लेक्सिया एक तंत्रिका-जैविक (neurobiological) भाषा-आधारित विशिष्ट अधिगम अक्षमता (SLD) है। इसका प्राथमिक और मुख्य लक्षण सटीक व धाराप्रवाह शब्द पहचान (Word Recognition), वर्तनी (Spelling) और ध्वन्यात्मक डिकोडिंग (Decoding) में गंभीर कठिनाई होना है। इसका मूल कारण मस्तिष्क में भाषा के ध्वन्यात्मक प्रसंस्करण (Phonological Processing) में कमी होना है (जैसा कारण R में सही कहा गया है)। डिस्लेक्सिया से पीड़ित बच्चों में पठन बोध (Comprehension) की समस्या प्राथमिक नहीं होती, बल्कि शब्दों को डिकोड करने में उनकी अधिकांश संज्ञानात्मक ऊर्जा खर्च हो जाने का द्वितीयक परिणाम होती है। यदि किसी छात्र की डिकोडिंग उत्तम है और केवल समझ कमजोर है, तो उसे 'विशिष्ट पठन बोध विकार' कहा जाता है, डिस्लेक्सिया नहीं। अतः अभिकथन (A) गलत है और कारण (R) सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Dyslexia is primarily characterized by severe difficulties in accurate and fluent word recognition, phonological decoding, and spelling, rather than poor reading comprehension with intact decoding. Because dyslexia affects phonological processing of words, reading comprehension difficulties typically arise as a secondary consequence of decoding struggles rather than an isolated deficit.

question_english: When adapting an examination or test for a student with Dyscalculia, an educator should ideally:
options_english: Eliminate all conceptual word problems and present strictly basic rote numerical calculation drills on written assessments
Administer an alternative standardized examination designed for students enrolled three grade levels below the student’s current placement
Require the student to complete all examination components orally without providing any scratch paper or written reference materials
Permit calculators, multiplication charts, or visual number lines to focus assessment on mathematical reasoning
explanation_english: Dyscalculia is a specific learning disability that affects a student's number sense, memorization of basic arithmetic facts, and computational fluency. However, conceptual mathematical reasoning, spatial logic, and higher-order problem-solving abilities are frequently intact. In inclusive education, an 'accommodation' removes unnecessary processing barriers without lowering academic standards or altering the construct being measured. Permitting assistive aids such as calculators, printed multiplication tables, concrete manipulatives, or visual number lines circumvents the retrieval and computational speed deficit, enabling the teacher to evaluate the student’s actual mathematical logic, conceptual understanding, and problem-solving strategies. Option A penalizes the core disability while eliminating higher-order thinking. Option B represents an inappropriate curriculum downgrade. Option C strains working memory and creates severe cognitive overload.
explanation_hindi: डिस्कैलकुलिया (Dyscalculia) एक विशिष्ट अधिगम अक्षमता है जो संख्या बोध (number sense), बुनियादी अंकगणितीय तालिकाओं को याद रखने और गणना गति को प्रभावित करती है। किंतु ऐसे छात्रों में उच्च-स्तरीय गणितीय तर्क, अमूर्त विचार और समस्या-समाधान की क्षमता सामान्य या उत्कृष्ट हो सकती है। समावेशी शिक्षा का सिद्धांत 'समायोजन' (Accommodation) पर बल देता है, जिसका उद्देश्य मूल शैक्षणिक मानक को कम किए बिना बच्चे की बाधा को दूर करना है। परीक्षा के दौरान साधारण कैलकुलेटर, दृश्य संख्या रेखा (Number lines) या गुणा तालिकाओं के प्रयोग की अनुमति देने से रटंत गणना की रुकावट समाप्त हो जाती है और शिक्षक यह निष्पक्ष मूल्यांकन कर पाता है कि विद्यार्थी गणितीय अवधारणाओं और तार्किक प्रक्रियाओं को कितनी अच्छी तरह समझता है। विकल्प A बच्चे की कमजोरी को ही दंडित करता है। विकल्प B पाठ्यक्रम का अनावश्यक अवमूल्यन है। विकल्प C कार्यकारी स्मृति पर अत्यधिक बोझ डालता है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Permit calculators or visual number lines to focus assessment on mathematical reasoning

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: focus assessment on mathematical reasoning Adapting assessments for students with Dyscalculia involves providing accommodations like calculators, visual number lines, or multiplication grids. These tools bypass underlying rote numerical recall and calculation speed deficits, enabling the assessment to focus accurately on evaluating the student’s higher- order mathematical reasoning, conceptual understanding, and problem-solving abilities.

question_english: Which of the following represents the primary, defining characteristic of a “Gifted Underachiever” in educational psychology?
options_english: Possessing below-average general cognitive ability while demonstrating consistently poor academic performance across all school subjects
Excelling academically across all core subject areas while struggling exclusively with physical education and motor coordination tasks
Showing a significant discrepancy between high intellectual potential and noticeably lower academic performance
Exhibiting academic learning drive that is motivated exclusively by tangible external rewards such as letter grades or formal certificates
explanation_english: In educational psychology and gifted pedagogy, a 'Gifted Underachiever' is identified by a statistically and clinically significant gap between their demonstrated high intellectual ability or creative potential (typically measured through standardized cognitive assessments, IQ tests, or exceptional non-verbal problem solving) and their actual scholastic performance in the classroom. Key contributors to gifted underachievement include: unchallenging and repetitive curricula causing chronic disengagement and boredom; unrecognized twice-exceptionality (2e, such as giftedness combined with ADHD or dyslexia); perfectionism and fear of failure; low self-efficacy; or unsupportive socio-emotional environments. Option A describes borderline intellectual functioning or generalized intellectual disability. Option B reflects developmental coordination disorder (dyspraxia). Option D describes pure extrinsic motivation. Therefore, Option C is correct.
explanation_hindi: शिक्षा मनोविज्ञान में 'प्रतिभाशाली अल्प-उपलब्धिकर्ता' (Gifted Underachiever) उस विद्यार्थी को कहा जाता है जिसकी बौद्धिक क्षमता, अमूर्त तर्क और रचनात्मक क्षमता बहुत उच्च (Gifted) होती है, किंतु विद्यालयी परीक्षाओं में उसका वास्तविक प्रदर्शन उसकी इस आंतरिक क्षमता की तुलना में काफी कम होता है। इस विसंगति (Discrepancy) के प्रमुख कारणों में शामिल हैं: कक्षा में दोहरावदार व नीरस शिक्षण जिससे बच्चा ऊब जाता है; अज्ञात 'द्वि-विशिष्टता' (Twice-Exceptionality / 2e - जैसे प्रतिभा के साथ डिस्लेक्सिया या ADHD का होना); अत्यधिक पूर्णतावाद (perfectionism) या असफलता का डर; और उपयुक्त शैक्षणिक प्रेरणा का अभाव। विकल्प A सामान्य बौद्धिक दुर्बलता को दर्शाता है। विकल्प B गामक समन्वय संबंधी विकार है। विकल्प D बाह्य अभिप्रेरणा का लक्षण है। अतः उच्च बौद्धिक क्षमता और निम्न शैक्षणिक उपलब्धि के बीच का अंतर ही इसका मुख्य लक्षण है (विकल्प C)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Showing a gap between high intellectual potential and lower academic performance

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: potential and lower academic performance A “Gifted Underachiever” is defined by a significant discrepancy between high intellectual ability or potential (demonstrated through cognitive assessments or creative problem- solving) and lower-than-expected academic performance in school. Unaddressed boredom, learning disabilities, emotional distress, or inappropriate instructional pacing often contribute to this performance gap.

question_hindi: प्रमस्तिष्कीय पक्षाघात (Cerebral Palsy) से ग्रसित एक माध्यमिक विद्यार्थी की बौद्धिक क्षमता सामान्य है, किंतु उसकी दोनों भुजाओं में गंभीर मांसपेशीय ऐंठन (Spasticity) है, जिससे उसके लिए हाथ से लिखना सर्वथा असंभव है। इस संदर्भ में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण शैक्षणिक हस्तक्षेप क्या होना चाहिए?

हस्तलेखन संबंधी भावनात्मक कुंठा को दूर करने के लिए औपचारिक संज्ञानात्मक व्यवहार थेरेपी सत्र आयोजित करना

question_english: A secondary school student with cerebral palsy possesses average intelligence but has severe spasticity in both arms, rendering fine-motor writing impossible. What is the most critical and appropriate educational intervention?
options_english: Modifying the academic curriculum substantially to align with a significantly lower grade level standard
Providing assistive accommodations such as a scribe, speech-to-text software, or an adapted keyboard
Implementing formal cognitive behavioral therapy sessions to address handwriting-related emotional frustration
Transferring the child permanently to a specialized residential facility designed for severe intellectual disabilities
explanation_english: Cerebral palsy is a neurological condition caused by damage to the developing brain, primarily affecting posture, muscle tone, and voluntary motor coordination. Crucially, motor impairment does not correlate with cognitive impairment—many individuals with severe physical spasticity possess normal, superior, or gifted intellect. In this scenario, because the barrier is strictly fine-motor execution (handwriting) rather than cognitive comprehension, modifying the curriculum to a lower grade level (Option A) or segregating the student into an intellectual disability institution (Option D) is pedagogically inappropriate and legally discriminatory under the RPwD Act, 2016. The correct intervention is providing assistive technology and reasonable accommodations (Option B): an examination scribe, voice recognition software (speech-to-text), eye-gaze tracking, or adapted keyguards/switches. These allow the student to access and express standard grade-level curriculum seamlessly. Option C ignores the physiological nature of spasticity.
explanation_hindi: प्रमस्तिष्कीय पक्षाघात (Cerebral Palsy) मस्तिष्क के गामक नियंत्रण केंद्रों की क्षति के कारण होता है, जो मांसपेशियों की गति, ऐंठन (Spasticity) और समन्वय को प्रभावित करता है। इसका बच्चे की बौद्धिक क्षमता से कोई प्रत्यक्ष संबंध नहीं होता—गंभीर शारीरिक पक्षाघात वाले बच्चे की बुद्धि सामान्य या असाधारण भी हो सकती है। चूंकि इस मामले में छात्र की संज्ञानात्मक क्षमता सामान्य है और समस्या केवल हाथ से लिखने की गामक बाधा है, इसलिए पाठ्यक्रम के स्तर को नीचे गिराना (विकल्प A) या उसे बौद्धिक अक्षमता वाले संस्थान में भेजना (विकल्प D) घोर अनुचित और RPwD अधिनियम 2016 के तहत अधिकारों का हनन है। यहां अनिवार्य हस्तक्षेप 'उचित समायोजन और सहायक तकनीक' (Accommodations & Assistive Technology) उपलब्ध कराना है—जैसे लेखक (Scribe), आवाज को पाठ में बदलने वाला सॉफ्टवेयर (Speech-to-text), अथवा अनुकूलित कीबोर्ड। यह छात्र को अपनी बौद्धिक समझ को मानक स्तर पर निर्बाध रूप से व्यक्त करने में सक्षम बनाता है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Providing a scribe, speech-to-text software, or an adapted keyboard

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: or an adapted keyboard A student with cerebral palsy who possesses average intelligence but experiences severe motor spasticity requires accommodations that bypass fine-motor writing barriers. Providing assistive tools—such as a scribe, speech-to-text software, or customized adapted keyboards—allows the student to express academic knowledge effectively without modifying standard grade- level curriculum expectations.

question_hindi:
सूची-I में उल्लिखित विशिष्ट दिव्यांगता को सूची-II में दी गई उपयुक्त शिक्षण रणनीति के साथ सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (दिव्यांगता)
P. ऑटिज्म स्पेक्ट्रम विकार (ASD)
Q. दृष्टि दिव्यांगता
